avis.texte: If you have very sensitive rosacea be very cautious about using this product. I use prescribed azelaic acid 15% and this moisturizer pilled no matter how long i waited between application. It would cause burning and flushing towards the end of the day, and when I would apply it at night I would wake up with the oiliest t-zone (oil would literally be pooling in my pores). Was not a fan of the consistency, it was similar to elmers glue buy thicker making it difficult to spread around, leading to tugging on the skin.
I have rosceasea and I started using this two months ago every day and my redness and irritation is completely gone, no more redness and it does wonders under make up.

I don't normally leave reviews but I need to warn my fellow rosacea girlies. This product's second ingredient is Octyldodecanol. In three separate scientific studies this ingredient was identified as an irritant, even in very small amounts. In addition, the presence of this ingredient *enhanced* the irritation of other ingredients. So why would they put it in a product for people with sensitive, reactive skin? Save your money. I got a rash all over my cheeks.

I was really unsure about trying this product, since some of the reviews are really bad, but I am SOSOSOSO glad I did. WOW. I have tried SO many products for my Type 1 Rosacea. I have no acne, but I will flush like a tomato at the drop of a feather. I was even at the point of considering prescription medications. Within ~5 days, my flushing had SIGNIFICANTLY reduced. Within ~10 days, I have not have a single episode of flushing. My face no longer feels like it's constantly burning. I use this every AM & every PM. I've already repurchased two more bottles because I seriously cannot live without this product. The consistency is pretty lightweight, so I put a more intensive moisturizer on top of it. Despite what some have mentioned, my product has no obvious smell.

I never write reviews but ive used this product twice and already feel inclined to leave a 5 star review. I have been struggling with redness, irritation, and dry skin since i was little. I've used just about every product under the sun trying to get it under control. Most recently i started using some dermatologist prescribed products for my acne, which has made my face absolutely freak out. My eyelids were flaking like excema and the corners around my mouth are too painful to even open. I found this product and was desperate so i gave it a try. TWO TRIES!!!! And ive finally found a solution!!! Lately even just putting on moisturizer after my prescription products was making my skin tingle and sting all over and get very plump and red. I put this product on in between those steps and felt INSANT relief. Im so happy i found this profuct.
Big Avene fan and rosacea girly. This didnt work for me and caused a rash. Not sure which ingredient I may be allergic to but beware if yorue extra senstive like me

avis.titre: Die hard SkinCeuticals fan for 10 years
avis.texte: I've been a diehard skin cueticals fan for at least 10 years. The products keep going up in price but I kept paying for them. I had seen this moisturizer around, on different blogs for a few years. It caught my eye because I suffer from rosacea which is under control with laser treatment and my skin care regimen. I was running out of my regular products that I use from SkinCeuticals and I was inside of Ulta and I just decided to give this a try. I thought if I didn't like it, I could return it (which I truly truly thought would happen because I've never been able to switch from SkinCeuticals to a lesser priced product and I've tried numerous times over the years)….. a few weeks went by and I've had no negative effects, if anything my skin looks great, it looks just as good as when i use my SC moisturizer. I actually prefer this one more because it's lighter. This led me to trying their hydrance boost serum, which I'm happy to report is amazing. I've had nothing but positive effects from these skin care products and I've been able to stop spending a small fortune on SkinCeuticals. I was also pleased to see someone else had left a review similar to mine about trying these products in place of SkinCeuticals, it made me feel more valid on how I felt. Truly, I recommend giving this line a chance, especially if you're used to very bougie skin care like i was.

avis.titre: Helped severe Type 1 and 2 Rosacea flare
avis.texte: I have ultra sensitive skin plus was recently diagnosed with Type 1 Erythematotelangiectatic Rosacea and Type 2 Papulopustular Rosacea. This Avène Redness Expert product is one of the things that has actually helped. I have tried many similar products over the past two months. Others either made my condition worse, didn't absorb, and/or caused my medication to lift or pill. This product works well with my topical medication and took my face from an alarmingly (and very painful) bright red back to close to normal in a week's time.

This gentle treatment helps calm my rosacea-prone skin. I use it in the morning before I put on my sunscreen. It's gentle and it has calmed my skin when I am having a rosacea flareup. It doesn't burn and melts into my skin, while also moisturizing it, but not leaving it greasy.

Avene Redness Expert - I'm usually tomato red in my cheeks for an hour after my shower; I took this 15 minutes after I got out. I'm still slightly red, but I've only used this consistently for about a week and have genuine noticed an improvement! I'll rebuy this when I'm out.
I received this serum for free from avene and influenster is exchange for my honest review. This serum is very small for the price. I use it when my face is inflame

avis.titre: Avène Redness Expert Soothing Moisturizing Concent

I rarely wear makeup, but when I do this has worked well under it - I try to give it 30+ minutes to absorb before applying foundation. I'm sensitive to synthetic fragrances, so my options are limited and this one works well for me. I'm using other treatments so it's hard to say if this cream alone is helping the redness, but overall my redness is down. I was using a much more expensive cream and actually prefer this. Back to buy another bottle!
Works as intended, nice texture, doesnt break me out or feel greasy. A little pricey but will wait for a sale and would repurchase.

This was a little out of my usual price range for skin care but i thought what the heck, lets give this a shot. At first, i didnt see any immediate results but i continued to use anyway because some skin care products can take months of use before showing dramatic results. I used this twice a day as it recommends. I had to stop using it after month 2 because it was causing me to break out. It is not for sensitive skin. It made my roscea much worse. I had to throw it away. Def dont waste your money on this.
def helped with redness but needs a super hydrating serum/moisturizer on top

Unfortunately, this cream is a fail for me from Avene. The formula is light, but it just feels like it sits on my skin without actually doing anything. It didn't help at all with my redness. For the price, there are definitely other creams out there that at least offer some hydration.

My usual skin care regimen and prescription topicals didn't help when winter blew at my face and hands. I bought this because it tries to address the burning, cracking, and tightness of my cheeks, not just cover the redness and visible veins. I can't touch my face so much because of the pain due to the sensitivity. I like that I don't have to manipulate my skin further just to wipe it off. There's no green pigment on this one but I just used it for 2 days with the lotion, Cicalfate+ Restorative Cream, sunscreen and thermal water, and all the symptoms are barely there. That's the fastest I've ever been relieved! I'd take weeks to a month with other brands and layers of petroleum jelly to recover. This saved me skin care steps and my sanity.
1 month of use. The cream is a good moisturizer but I didn't notice a visible improvement in the redness. Also it pills a bit. I will not buy it again

I have hyper-reactive rosacea skin that doesn't like a lot of the trendy ingredients (e.g., hyaluronic acid and niacinamide) that have made their way into every possible skin care and makeup product these days. My skin also needs a moisturizer that strikes a balance between too light (leaves my face feeling too dry/tight) and too heavy (causes my face to flush from trapped heat). I decided to try this moisturizer and have been really pleased with it. I'm on my second bottle now and, other than the price tag, I'm happy with the level of moisturizing it provides, the soothing qualities, and how it wears under sunscreen and makeup.
Helps my rosacea and spreads smoothly. I have dry skin on my face and a small amount of this last all day. Or night.

Helped my skin become baby soft and less red within one week of use. Suffer from rosacea, eczema, and adult acne. For over a year my facial skin was inflamed, irritated, and textured like sandpaper. Using this morning and evening on face neck and chest has made a noticeable difference that I can't quite believe myself. Only one pump for face then another for neck and chest and I rub in gently and evenly. Im sensitive to medications and the rosacea journey has been rough. I started with high end luxury creams and serums. Most of them irritated me with their fragrances and "natural ingredients" like essential oils or miracle broths. This cream worked for me and is also worked for my bank account! It's rich and fragrance free, but it does leave a "glow" for a bit so if you're super oily you may not like it. The whole Avene line has been a lifesaver and I will stick with it. Wishing everyone luck on their skincare journey!!! I know not every product will work for every person but for me, with these issues it was impressive and I would encourage anyone to give it a go.

avis.titre: Redness gone in a few days
avis.texte: This is one of the best redness cream that I tried. It works and helps reduce the redness to none.
Consistency was good; however it was a little too harsh for my skin.

This was a real disappointment. My dry skin with Rosacea issues looks and feels greasy when I use this. Bring back the antirougers Forte please! I made the mistake of purchasing two of this while it was on sale when the Forte was no longer available. I can only use it at night unless I want to look like an oil slick.

Truly amazing. I have rosacea with pustules, and have never found anything that soothed my dehydrated skin and didn't cause breakouts. I've been using for a month now, and truly my skin has never been better. I tried this on a whim and am so grateful every morning to have soft, non irritated skin.
Excellent product. I've used other anti-redness products but this works!

I have tried a lot of products to combat my redness due to rosacea. This applies very well and feels great. It is too early to tell if it is truly correcting my redness. But as long as you put it on and let it set before your next step, whether it is foundation or powder makeup, it stays in place and doesn't interfere with makeup!
Soothing. Calms redness . But I wish its effect is more lasting. Will continue to use it to see how it goes long term.
It worked and reduced rednesses but my skin peeled so much I had to stop using it. It took a week to stop peeling.

avis.titre: Soothes the redness, looks so much better
avis.texte: I have had redness all my life. This cream is soothing and takes my redness away. It is not oily, leaves my face moisturized and calm.

Cream, Soothing, No Tint, No Residue, extra sensitive skin on face, especially cheeks, I mean I get red from taking too warm temperature of a shower. I don't want to feel, sense that my pores are clogged, I only want calming, soothing, healthy, product on skin, other than a Serum, this is next best!
Really hydrating! More so than the Hydrance products in my opinion, I'll be buying it for that reason alone.

Let me start by saying I love all Avène products and have not had a bad experience with any of purchases. However, this moisturizer tends to peel in small pieces when using Avène products or not. It's almost play-doh like pieces of the moisturizer that starts to rub off after applying mineral sunscreen. I stopped using it and therefore cannot give a rating on the redness efficacy because of the peeling I experienced.

I don't see a big change in the redness on my cheeks after using this product. I doubt I will repurchase. I'm using it with the Avene cleanser and thermal water. I do like the fact that there's no added fragrance and it's moisturizing but as far a reduction in redness, it hasn't done that for me.
As soon as you put this on, its sticky and messy. You start to rub it in and it instantly pills and feels nasty. I definitely think they missed the mark on this one.
I am in my mid fifties and never really found anything to help my redness. This product does an amazing job! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Great mild moisturizer with no irritation!
avis.texte: My aging and reactive skin loves this moisturizer. It is soothing-not too much of anything. Just right for combination skin in a hot humid environment. Calms my mild rosacea. Love it!!!
The texture going on is nice, but after trying to blend it in, it starts to pill. Not a fan at all…

I am loving this product, it's been about a week so far and no reactions. I have very sensitive skin, dryness and redness so bad that don't like to go out . I have tried so many different treatments and all failed so far this is great ! I wear alone and with makeup no problems at all , I am also using the cleanser and other products from this company.

I have been using this for two weeks now and so far I am impressed with the moisturization and relief that I have with this product. I don't have full blown rosacea but my checks flare when i'm hot, eat spicy food, etc.. I found that this helps with the flares. My only issue is that it seems to pill once you add anything on top that isn't an oil. Especially sunscreen. Because, of that this gets a 4. If it didn't pill at all I would have found a holy grail moisturizer.
